# Invoice Email to confirmation

## Purpose
This procedure documents a workflow observed 819 times across 6 employee(s) during the observation window. It accounts for an estimated 359 hours per year across the organisation, plus a further 117 hours of context-switching cost.

## Trigger
Begins when a invoice email arrives in gmail.

## Systems Touched
gmail, pdf, sheets

## Procedure
1. Open and read invoice email in gmail.
2. Extract the required fields from fields in pdf.
3. Create a new row in sheets.
4. Send the confirmation in gmail.

## Known Exceptions
- 39 distinct step sequences were observed; 62% of instances follow the order above.
- 6 step position(s) varied between instances and may require a judgement call.

## Owner
Accounts Payable team.

## Estimated Duration
6.3 minutes (median of 819 observed instances).

# Purchase Order to match log

## Purpose
This procedure documents a workflow observed 440 times across 5 employee(s) during the observation window. It accounts for an estimated 148 hours per year across the organisation, plus a further 58 hours of context-switching cost.

## Trigger
Begins when a purchase order arrives in erp.

## Systems Touched
erp, sheets

## Procedure
1. Open and read purchase order in erp.
2. Search for the matching invoice in erp.
3. Update the match log in sheets.

- 4 step position(s) varied between instances and may require a judgement call.

## Owner
